The interceptor guidance begins at segment 3 at a time of 37.059 seconds. The guid- 
ance immediately commands a pitchover with negative angle of attack and then stays 
on anear straight-line path. When the interceptor nears the target, it must make more 
rapid corrections. At the end of the trajectory, the interceptor is at a maximum angle 
of attack of 15". Figure 4-21 shows the east position and altitude of the two trajecto- 
ries as they intercept.
